content: The snowy lane was illuminated by burning thatch and the bloody glare of torches. Black Wave cutthroats, clad in spiked armor, were kicking open granary doors when the shadow of the dried anchovy boy fell across the drifts.
critique: Sanderson: Strong biological limits and mechanical vector precision.
